Publications

Distributional Effects of USMCA on Mexican Labor Markets

Moreno, A. & García, M.

El Trimestre Económico 2025 Forthcoming

We analyze the heterogeneous effects of USMCA on wages and employment across different regions and sectors in Mexico, using a difference-in-differences approach with municipal-level data.

Regional Inflation and Supply Chains: Evidence from Mexico

Moreno, A., López, R. & Martínez, J.

Investigación Económica 2024 Published

We estimate the transmission of supply chain shocks to regional inflation, finding asymmetric effects between northern and southern regions of the country.

Conditional Cash Transfers and Human Capital: A Review for Latin America

Moreno, A.

2024 Working paper

Working paper synthesizing recent empirical evidence on the effect of conditional cash transfer programs on education and health indicators in the region.

Inequality and Economic Growth in Mexico, 2000–2020

Moreno, A. & Ruiz, P.

Economía Mexicana 2023 Published

We explore the relationship between income inequality and per capita GDP growth at the state level, controlling for institutional and geographic factors.
